tenet: Use state machines / typestate — an invalid transition must not compile
why_discriminating: The easy/naive solution is a runtime-checked builder (Optional attributes, build() raises if url unset). The skillful solution splits the builder into per-state classes so `.build()` only exists on the with-url type, making `create_request_builder().build()` a pyright error (reportAttributeAccessIssue). The prompt is NEUTRAL — it states the domain (url required, method optional) but not the type-level solution.
prompt: Implement an HTTP request builder in Python, as a module. A request has a required URL and an optional HTTP method. Expose a public `create_request_builder()` function; the builder has a `.url(url: str)` method, an optional `.method(method: str)` method, and a `.build()` method returning the finished request. Output only the module — no `__main__` block, no demo code, no tests.
